mapper.sql: id, review_type, target_module, target_type, target_id, target_revision_ref, target_display_name, applicant_account_id, applicant_display_name, submission_note, status, reviewer_account_id, decision_reason, submitted_at, decided_at, canceled_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_review_request ( review_type, target_module, target_type, target_id, target_revision_ref, target_display_name, applicant_account_id, applicant_display_name, submission_note, status, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{reviewType}, #{targetModule}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetRevisionRef}, #{targetDisplayName}, #{applicantAccountId}, #{applicantDisplayName}, #{submissionNote}, #{status}, #{submittedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_review_request SET status = 'APPROVED', reviewer_account_id = #{reviewerAccountId}, decision_reason = #{reason}, decided_at = #{decidedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE sr_review_request SET status = 'REJECTED', reviewer_account_id = #{reviewerAccountId}, decision_reason = #{reason}, decided_at = #{decidedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE sr_review_request SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, -- 取消是申请人自己的动作，此时还没有决策人；清空决策字段避免留下半截状态 reviewer_account_id = NULL, decision_reason = NULL, decided_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
